name: Wikimedia Commons artwork
noteNameFormat: {{selector:#fileinfotpl_art_artist + td a, #fileinfotpl_art_painter + td a, #fileinfotpl_aut + td a|nth:1|replace:"/\s*\(.*\).*/gs":""|safe_name}} - {{selector:#fileinfotpl_art_date + td, #fileinfotpl_date + td|replace:"/[^0-9]*([0-9]{4}).*/gs":"$1"}} - {{selector:#fileinfotpl_art_title + td [lang]|nth:1|replace:"/title ?QS:.*/gis":""|safe_name}}

properties.name: artist
properties.value: {{selector:#fileinfotpl_art_artist + td a, #fileinfotpl_art_painter + td a, #fileinfotpl_aut + td a|nth:1}}

properties.name: artist_url
properties.value: {{selector:#fileinfotpl_art_artist + td a?href, #fileinfotpl_art_painter + td a?href, #fileinfotpl_aut + td a?href|nth:1}}
